site: Greenhouse (Datadog 'Preferred First Name*'); any form that requires a field the profile leaves blank on purpose
class: A field the profile says has no value was emptied even where the form requires it, and a 'Label*' star without a space was not read as required
symptom: Datadog's required 'Preferred First Name*' was typed by the session, then emptied by the runtime ('your profile says there is none'); the form could not be sent.
root_cause: preferred_name is in BLANK_MEANS_NONE, so known_answer returned '' and _clear_none_boxes emptied the box, with no notion of the form requiring it. required_questions also only read 'Label *', not 'Label*'.
why_tests_missed: BLANK_MEANS_NONE was tested on optional boxes (UKG Address 2); no fixture had a required preferred-name box, and the star fixtures all had a space.
fix: config.REQUIRED_STAND_IN names the truthful stand-in for a required 'none' field (preferred_name -> first_name). known_answer gives it when the box is required (star on the label or name, 'required' in the name, or among the page's starred questions); _clear_none_boxes then has nothing to empty. required_questions reads 'Label*' too.
prevention: 'The profile says none' and 'the form requires one' are two facts; decide with both, and keep the stand-ins as data.
